description: Delete the bot's own reaction for a specific emoji on a message. This only removes the bot's reaction and does not affect other users. To delete another user's reaction, use discord_delete_user_message_reaction; to add a reaction, use discord_add_my_message_reaction. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Read Message History. Changes or removes existing Discord data without an approval prompt.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread holding the message

emoji.description: Emoji as a Unicode character ('👍') or its URL-encoded form ('%F0%9F%91%8D'), or a custom emoji as name:id ('party_blob:123456789012345678')

message_id.description: ID of the message to target
